description: Generate all GEO (AI search optimization) assets for a website in one shot. Returns ready-to-use Organization Schema JSON-LD, FAQ Schema JSON-LD, llms.txt, and robots.txt snippet — so AI search engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and Claude can find, understand, and cite the site. Use this when building or updating a website and the user wants AI search visibility. No API key required.
